spans.s:
अपुंस् अ-पुंस्, -पुमान्, m. not a man, a
eunuch.
—अपुंस्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a eunuch.
अ-पुंस्का, f. without a husband.

अपुच्छ अ-पुच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, tailless; (आ),
f. the tree Dalbergia Śiśu.

अपुण्य अ-पुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unclean, im-
pure, wicked, bad.
—अपुण्य-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, acting
wickedly, wicked, bad.

अपुत्र अ-पुत्र, अस्, m. not a son; (अस्, आ, अम्),
or अ-पुत्रक, अस्, इका, अम्, having no son, sonless.
—अपुत्र-ता, f. sonlessness.

अ-पुत्रिका, f. the daughter of a sonless father, who
herself has no male offspring; (अस्), m. the father of
such a daughter.

अपुनर् अ-पुनर्, ind. not again, once for
ever.
—अ-पुनः-प्राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, irrecoverable.
—अ-पुनर्-अन्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, not returning, dead.

—अ-पुनर्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. final exemption from life
or transmigration.
—अ-पुनर्-दीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्,
not being given back.
—अ-पुनर्-भव, अस्, m. not
being again; exemption of the soul from further
transmigration, final beatitude.
—अ-पुनर्-भाव,
अस्, m. not being born again.

अपुराण अ-पुराण, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-पुरातन,
अस्, ई, अम्, not old, modern, new.

आ-पूरण, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming full; (अस्), m.,
N. of a Nāga; (अम्), n. filling, making full.

अपुरुष अ-पुरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, unmanly.
—अ-पुरुषार्थ (˚ष-अर्˚) अस्, m. a rite which
is not for the benefit of the sacrificer; not the chief
object of the soul.

अपूरुष अ-पूरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, lifeless, in-
animate; soulless; unpeopled.
—अ-पूरुष-घ्न, अस्,
m., Ved. not killing men.

अपुरोऽनुवाक्यक अ-पुरो-ऽनुवाक्यक, अस्,
अका, or इका, अम्, without a Puronuvākyā.
अ-पुरोरुक्क, अस्, आ, अम्, without a Puroruc.

अपुष्कल अ-पुष्कल, अस्, आ, अम्, not emi-
nent; mean, low.

अपुष्ट अ-पुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, unnourished,
lean; soft.

अपुष्प अ-पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, not flowering;
(अस्), m. the glomerous fig tree.
—अ-पुष्प-फल
or अ-पुष्प-फल-द, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing fruits
without flowering; having neither flowers nor fruits;
(अस्), m. the jack tree, Artocarpus Integrifolia, the
glomerous fig-tree.

अपुस् अपुस्, उस्, n., Ved. shape; the same
as वपुस्, q. v.

अपूजक अ-पूजक, अस्, इका, अम्, irreverent,
irreligious.
अ-पूजा, f. irreverence, disrespect.

अ-पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, not reverenced or worshipped,
contemned, disregarded.

अ-पूज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be worshipped or
revered.

अपूत अ-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, impure; not having
received the invocatory rite.

अपूप अपूप, अस्, m. cake of flour, meal, &c.;
a sort of bread; wheat; honey-comb (?).
—अपूप-
नाभि, इस्, m., Ved. having a navel which consists of
or is decorated with cake.
—अपूप-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of cake.
—अपूप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accom-
panied with cake.
—अपूपापिहित (˚प-अप्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, covered with cake.
अपूपीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to cake.
अपूप्य, अम्, n. flour, meal.
आपूप्य, अम्, n. flour, meal.

अपूरणी अपूरणी f. the silk cotton tree,
Bombax Heptaphyllum.

अपूर्ण अ-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, not full or entire,
imperfect, incomplete, deficient; (अम्), n. an incom-
plete number, a fraction.
—अपूर्ण-काल, अस्, आ, अम्,
premature; (अस्), m. incomplete time.
—अपूर्ण-
काल-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born before the proper time, abor-
tive.
—अपूर्ण-ता, f. incompleteness.
अ-पूर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, not being full, incomplete.

आ-पूर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming full, being
filled.
—आपूर्यमाण-पक्ष, अस्, m. the crescent
or waxing moon.

अपूर्व अ-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, unpreceded, un-
precedented; not having existed before, quite new;
unparalleled, incomparable, wonderful, extraordinary;
not first; (in Pāṇini) preceded by अ or आ; (अम्),
n. the remote or unforeseen consequence of an act,
as heaven of religious rites; a consequence not im-
mediately preceded by its cause.
—अपूर्व-कर्मन्,
अ, n. a religious rite or sacrifice, the power of which
on the future is not before seen.
—अपूर्व-ता, f. or
अपूर्व-त्व, अम्, n. the being unpreceded, not hav-
ing existed before, incomparableness, &c.
—अ-पूर्व-
पति, इस्, f. one who has had no husband before.
—अपूर्व-वत्, ind. singularly, unlike anything else.
—अ-पूर्वेण, ind. never before.

अ-पूर्वीय, अस्, आ, अम्, referring to the remote or
unforeseen consequence of an act.

आपू आ-पू, cl. 1. A. -पवते, -वितुम्, to be
pure; to flow towards after purification; to carry
towards in its course (said of a stream).

आपूपिक आपूपिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अपूप),
selling cakes; accustomed to eat cakes; fond of cakes,
eating cakes (with benefit); a good maker of cake;
(अस्), m. a baker; a confectioner; (अम्), n. a mul-
titude of cakes.

आपूय् आ-पूय्, cl. 1. P. -पूयति, -यितुम्, to
be putrescent, putrify.
आपूष आपूष, अम्, n. tin.
आ-पूर, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming full.
आ-पूर्ति, इस्, f. filling; fulness, satisfaction.
आ-पूर्य, ind. filling, having filled.
